application: Approximate formulas (p.10)
notes: Reaction force Q [N] = 1.5 * E3 / s ; Stopping time t [s] = 2.6 * s / vD ; Deceleration a [m/s2] = 0.75 * vD^2 / s. Approximate values assuming correct adjustment, add safety margin. Key: E1 kinetic energy per cycle; E2 propelling force energy per cycle; E3 = E1 + E2 total energy per cycle; E4 = E3 * c total energy per hour (valid at room temp only); We effective weight = 2*E3/vD^2 (= W when no propelling force); c cycles/hr; n absorbers in parallel -> divide E3, E4, We by n. vD = final impact velocity; with accelerating (e.g. pneumatic) motion final velocity can be 1.5-2x average. ST stall torque factor normally 2.5; g = 9.81.

notes: vD = v; We = W. E4 = E3*c.

notes: We = 2*E3/vD^2 = 2*51/1.5^2 = 45 kg. Variants: 2.1 vertical up E2=(F-W*g)*s; 2.2 vertical down E2=(F+W*g)*s. v = final impact velocity; pneumatic systems 1.5-2x average.
